m: उद्-√ बाध् Ā. -बाधते, to burst forth, break forth, ŚBr.

v: tri॰ uttolitI(vA)bAhuryena prA॰ ba॰ । uttolitavAhO “prAMSulaBye Pale loBAdudbAhuriva vAmanaH raGuH ।
m: उद्-बाहु mfn. having the arms raised
extending the arms, ŚBr.; Ragh. i, 3.
a: उद्बाहु — a. 1 Having the arms raised, stretching or extending the arms; प्रांशुलभ्ये फले लोभादुद्बाहुरिव वामनः R. 1. 3. --2 Having the trunk upraised (as an elephant).

m: उद्-बाहुक mfn. id., ĀśvGṛ. iv, 1, 9.
उद्-बाष्प See उद्-वाष्प.
a: उद्बाष्प — a. Filled or suffused with tears; Ki. 3. 59; न… मम नयनयोरुद्बाष्पत्वं सखे न भविष्यति V. 2. 10 tears will gush up in the eyes.

m: उद्-बध्य ind.p. having tied up or hanged one's self, hanging one's self, Rājat.; Kathās.; Pañcat.

a: उद्बंध् — {c9c} P. To hang, tie up; कंठमुद्बध्नाति Mu. 6; पादपे आत्मानमुद्बध्य व्यापादयामि Ratn. 3; Pt. 2.
उद्बंध — a. Loosened; R. 16. 67. --धः, --धनं 1 Tying up, hanging. --2 Hanging oneself.

उद्बंधकः — N. of a mixed tribe (doing the duty of washermen); cf Uśanas: --आयोगवेन विप्रायां जातास्ताम्रोपजीविनः . तस्यैव नृपकन्यायां जातःसूनिक उच्यते .. सूनिकस्य नृपायां तु जाता उद्बंधकाः स्मृताः . निर्णेजयेयुर्वस्त्राणि अस्पृशाश्च भवंत्यतः ..

m: उद्-बद्ध mfn. tied up or upwards, MBh.; Kum.
hung, hung up, MBh. iv, 13, 12
checked, interrupted
annulled, BhP. x, 85, 43
compact, firm (as the leg of a man), MBh.; VarBṛS.
उद्-बल mfn. strong, powerful (cf. उपोद्बलय.)
उद्-√ बन्ध् Ā. (Pot. -बध्नीत) to tie up, hang one's self, ŚBr. xi, 5, 1, 8.
1. उद्-बन्ध (for 2. See s.v.) m. hanging one's self, Kathās.; VarBṛS.
2. उद्-बन्ध (fr. बन्ध with उद् in sense of apart), mfn. unbound, loosened, untied (as hair), Ragh. xvi, 67 (ed. Calc.)
उद्-बन्ध m. (also) the son of a Khanaka and a Śūdrā, L.

v: pu॰ । (DopA) varRasaNkaraBede । “Ayogavena viprAyAM jAtAstAmropajIvinaH । tasyEva nfpakanyAyAM jAtaH sUnika ucyate । sUnikasya nfpAyAntu jAtA udbanDakAH smftAH । nirRejayeyurvastrARi aspfSyASca BavantyataH” uSanA ।

na॰ ud + banDa--BAve lyuw । UrdDataH pASAdinA galAdibanDane । “udbanDanamftA ye ca gatiryeGAM na vidyate । tezAmudDaraRArTAya imaM piRqaM dadAmyaham” vAyu pu॰ gayAmAhAtmye “vizamudbanDanaM cEva SastramagnipraveSanam । karizye na hi tAnfdDAn punardrazwumihotsahe” BA॰ va॰ 7 a॰ । “jalAgnyudbanDanaBrazwAH pravrajyAnaSanacyutAH । vizaprapatanaprAyAdAtmaGAtacyutASca ye । sarvve te pratyavasitAH sarvveDarmmabahizkftAH । cAndrAyaRena SudDyeyustaptakfcCradvayena vA” prA॰ vi॰ yamaH । BAve Gaj udbanGo'pyatra pu॰ ।
m: उद्बन्धन mf(ई)n. serving for hanging up (as a string), R. ii, 12, 80
उद्बन्धन n. hanging, hanging one's self, MBh.; Kathās.; Gaut.
उद्-बन्धुक mfn. one who hangs up, TS. ii, 5, 17.
उद्-बर्हिस् mfn. having sacrificial grass above, MaitrS. ii, 2, 3.
उद्-बृंहण mfn. (√ बृह्), increasing, strengthening, BhP.
उद्-बिल mfn. emerged from a hole, (an animal) that has quitted its hole, R.
a: उद्बिल — a. Out of the hole (an animal).

s: puM, (ut + buD + GaY .) kiYcit jYAnam ॥ (yaTA sAhityadarpaRe tftIyaparicCede 41 । “utsAhAdisamudboDaH sADAraRyABimAnataH । nfRAmapi samudrAdilaNGanAdO na duzyati” ॥)

m: उद्-बोध m. awaking
coming forth, appearing, Sāh.; Rājat.
fumigation, VarBṛS.
reminding
incipient knowledge, W.
a: उद्बोधः, --धनं — 1 Awakening, reminding. --2 Recalling to memory, rousing up; ननु कथं रामादिरत्याद्युद्बोधकारणैः सीतादिभिः सामाजिकानां रत्युद्बोधः S. D. 3; so रस˚.

m: उद्-बोधक mfn. exciting, calling forth, Sāh.
reminding
one who reminds or calls to remembrance
discovering, exhibiting, W.
a: उद्बोधक — a. 1 Reminding, that which reminds or calls to remembrance. --2 Exciting, rousing. --3 Discovering, exhibiting, showing. --कः N. of the sun.

m: उद्-बोधन n. awaking, arousing
recalling, reminding, W.
उद्-√ ब्रू Ā. -ब्रुवते, to extol, praise (see RTL. p. 424), TBr. i, 7, 10, 6; ŚBr. v; ii, 2, 4 (to renounce, give up, NBD.)
उद्-√ बुध् Ā. -बुध्यते (aor. 3. pl. -अबुध्रन्, RV.) to awake, RV. vii, 72, 3; x, 101, 1; VS.
a: उद्बुध् — {c1c} P. 1 To awaken, remind. --2 To arouse, animate, excite.

m: उद्-बुध्न्य Nom. (fr. -बुध्न) P. -बुध्न्यति, to come out of the deep, come or spring up, MaitrUp.

s: tri, (ut + buDa + kta .) vikasitaH । iti halAyuDaH ॥ (prabudDaH । yaTA tiTitattve, -- “udbudDAM ca jagadDAttrIM pUjayet dIpamAlayA” ॥ yaTA, sAhityadarpaRe 3 । 162 । “udbudDaM kAraREH svEH svErvahirBAvaM prakASayan । loke yaH kAryyarUpaH so'nuBAvaH kAvyanAvyayoH” ॥)
v: tri॰ ud + buDa--kta । 1 vikasite nyAyAdimate jYAtavastunaH saMbanDijYAnAdinA 2 kftoddIpane saMskAre ca । yaTA hastidarSanAt anuBUtahastipakasaMskArasya udboDarUpe uddIpane kfte hastipakaH smaryyate iti । 3 prabudDe 4 jAgarite ca “udbudDAM ca jagadDAtrIM pUjayeddIpamAlayA” ti॰ ta॰ pu॰ yena yena vastunA saMskAra udbuDyate taTA udboDakaSabde vakzyate । “udbudDaM kAraREH svEHsvErbahirBAvaM prakASayet” sA॰ da॰
m: उद्-बुद्ध mfn. roused up, awaked
come forth, appearing, Sāh.
blown, budded, L.
excited
reminded, made to think of, recalled, W.
a: उद्बुद्ध — p. p. 1 Awakened, aroused, excited; मनसि उद्बुद्धमात्रो विकारो भावः S. D. --2 Opened, expanded, full-blown; ˚कनकाब्ज Māl. 1. 40. --3 Reminded, made to think of. --4 Recalled to memory (as an object seen before). --Comp. --संस्कारः association of ideas, calling anything to mind.

m: उद्-बुद्ध—संस्कार m. association of ideas, recalling anything to remembrance.
उद्-बुद्बुद mfn. bubbling out forth, Mcar.
